body: Rotated big ImageNode for the minimap rejected: bevy_ui_render 0.19.1 clips by moving quad vertices against an axis-aligned rect ('this won't work with rotation/scaling'), so a rotated child of an Overflow::clip node is clipped wrong.

Minimap map, search circle, cop cones and player arrow drawn by one UiMaterial fragment shader over an unrotated node; markers stay UI nodes (unrotated). Alternative: CPU resample into a dynamic Image every frame (per-frame upload + CPU cost).

'Новый город' regenerates in-process: Paused -> Loading transition (NEW_CITY) despawns every CityScoped entity and resets per-domain city state; alternative process restart with --seed rejected (window reopens, BRP loses the process, orphan PIDs in brp.py).
Minimap raster and world->map projection are pure fns in citygen::minimap (GDD §2.2 step 8), gated under cargo test -p citygen; alternative client-crate pure fns gated by -p gta_like.

Client gets --settings-id flag (default reverse-domain const); tools/qa/brp.py launches with a .qa id so QA never reads or writes the owner's %LOCALAPPDATA% settings. Alternative: shared id (QA verdicts depend on owner's sensitivity/volume).

Esc pause request goes through gta_sim::flow::pause_request that refuses when NextState is not Unchanged (a same-frame fixed-tick Wasted/Busted would be overwritten); rejected: client-only check of State<GameState>.

Minimap projection helpers (project/map_px/heading_on_map) and M4/M5 move to src/minimap/projection.rs; raster stays in citygen. Rejected: projection in citygen (camera convention is client-owned, GDD 12 citygen = generation).
G3 uses production-bundle fixtures + State==Playing precondition instead of 400+1500 ticks of natural spawning at a gang post (death/arrest could route Busted->Paused).

Projection helpers (project/map_px/heading_on_map) and M4/M5 go back to citygen::minimap, reversing PLAN_V2 R11 (client src/minimap/projection.rs): GDD test plan lists 'проекция мини-карты' among headless gates of cargo test -p gta_sim/-p citygen and the AC names those commands. Client reaches them via gta_sim::world re-export (client has no citygen dependency).

PLAN_V2 G3 'each of the 7 Messages<..> len()==0' cannot compile for melee::Strike: it is pub(super) in combat/melee.rs:295, not nameable from crates/gta_sim/tests. Gate asserts the 6 public messages; Strike is still cleared inside combat.
PLAN_V2 G3 fixture order (spawn_unit, then raise_heat) panics: police_support::spawn_unit asserts stars >= 1 when SidewalkGraph exists. raise_heat must come first.

G3 reset-row flips made non-vacuous by dirtying each resettable resource/message by hand after pause (no fixed ticks run while paused) instead of relying on gameplay to have produced non-default state; alternative (natural play until each is non-default) rejected as slow and nondeterministic. Crimes stays asserted but is not independently flippable (private recorder, same system as WantedLevel).

Verdict PASS, not NEEDS_WORK: the missing U+21C4 toggle glyph in Inter and the hard-coded menu labels are owner-visible polish (value text still shows on/off), listed as minor for fixer/owner; alternative NEEDS_WORK rejected since no AC or silent-class gate is affected.

Font-coverage gate is a Python script (tools/qa/font_check.py, fontTools over strings.ron + src/menu/*.rs literals) instead of a Rust test with a ttf-parser dev-dependency: no Cargo.toml change, and the tools/qa precedent (tree_check.py) already hosts non-cargo gates.

Menu/settings clicks and Esc/Enter while paused driven by real OS input (SendInput via ctypes, scratch/qa/osinput.py) instead of BRP send_keys/mouse holds, which never release on the frozen virtual clock; alternative (unpausing Time<Virtual> over BRP) rejected as it changes the state under test.

Orphaned TnuaProximitySensor entities after 'Новый город' filed as a pre-existing leak (non-blocking, follow-up task) rather than NEEDS_FIXES: orphans grow ~1/s from civilian recycling before any new city; bevy-tnua TnuaSensorsSet has no linked_spawn. Alternative: block T12 on the leak.
